QuestInfo.name: The Best Dad
QuestInfo.0: It seems #p506# in #m10004000# was moved by her dad's cooking.
QuestInfo.1: After eating her dad's food, I think #b#p506##k in #b#m10004000##k came to understand his true feelings. She then asked me to convey her feelings to #b#p206##k in #b#m10001000##k. \r\n#rOnly characters at Level 17 or higher can complete this quest.#k
QuestInfo.2: I delivered the heartfelt message from his daughter, #p506#, to #p206# in #m10001000#. It might take time, but I feel like these two will be able to live happily together from now on.

0.0: I see... Dad made this dish for me... Hehe... Look at this. I've never seen such an ugly dish before. But... I've never tasted something this sweet and delicious in #m10004000# either. Really... sob...
0.1: I was so happy to find my long-lost dad, but to be honest, he felt a bit like a stranger at first. And after learning that my mom... is no longer in this world, I felt even sadder. But I had no idea Dad was trying this hard for me. I was so foolish.
0.2: I think I understand why Dad asked you to deliver this dish to me. So, could you pass my feelings along to him? And please tell him that I'll come visit #m10001000# again soon. I'm counting on you.

yes.0: Thank you so much. I'm going to think about things a bit more. And I'll try my best to become someone who can honestly express my feelings to Dad. Thank you for everything.

no.0: I see. You must be busy right now...

1.0: Ah, you're back! Did #p506# enjoy my food? I was worried if it suited her taste. What did she say? Tell me everything!
1.1: I see... She found her dad after 7 years, but learning her mom was no longer with us must have caused her so much pain. I should have paid closer attention to her, but I was so wrapped up in my research that I failed to notice her feelings. I truly regret it.
1.2: But I'm just glad I got to know her true feelings, even if it's now. This is all thanks to you. Alright! Please keep an eye on us from now on. Because I'm going to do my best to become the best dad for #p506#!

npc.0: I think I understand why Dad asked you to deliver this dish to me. So, I would really appreciate it if you could convey my feelings to my dad in #m10001000#.
